name: Consumption statement
description: Statement grouping energy consumption data for import.

statement_total.label: Statement total
statement_total.description: Total amount shown on the consumption statement.
statement_total.help: Enter this amount manually. The statement can be marked ready only when the line and allocation totals match it.

status.label: Status
status.description: Current status of the consumption statement.
status.help: Indicates the current processing stage of the statement.

action.mark_ready.label: Mark ready
action.mark_ready.description: Mark the consumption statement as ready for import.

action.mark_imported.label: Mark imported
action.mark_imported.description: Mark the consumption statement as imported.

errors.lines_total_mismatch: The total of the statement lines must match the statement total.
errors.allocations_total_mismatch: The total of the statement allocations must match the statement total.
